\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Open Sans",
}

\section{Warm paper}

\begin{frame}{A default bundle}
  The page is warm paper and the ink warm near-black.
  An \alert{azure emphasis} and a \textcolor{example}{green example}.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Tinted cards}
  \begin{block}{A plain card}
    Its band and body are tints of the warm paper.
  \end{block}
  \begin{alertblock}{An alerted card}
    Its band and body are tints of the azure.
  \end{alertblock}
  \begin{exampleblock}{An example card}
    Its title takes the green's tone on its band.
  \end{exampleblock}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[standout]
  Azure room.
